sample.question:
The image shows a six-face cube net. The cube starts with U on top, F in front, and R on the right. A roll north/east/south/west moves the cube in that direction without twisting.
The cube rolls in this order: south, south. Which emblem finishes on top?
A. Circle
B. Sun
C. Cross
D. Diamond
E. Triangle
F. Bars
sample.analysis: Track the orientation after each roll ['south', 'south']. The final top face is D, carrying the Circle emblem. The answer is A.
